queries.purpose: A finite sanity check of the two-loss charging relaxation with T=6, d=2, q=5; not a verification of arbitrary matchings or a universal theorem.
queries.input_contract: program with named bounded/free rational variables, MINIMIZE/MAXIMIZE rational objective, and labeled LE/EQ/GE rational rows; at most 32 variables and 64 constraints
queries.output_contract: OPTIMAL/PRIMAL_FEASIBLE/INFEASIBLE/UNBOUNDED/UNKNOWN with the original program and exact rational primal, dual, Farkas, or recession evidence
